artworks.title: The Battle Between the Gods and the Titans
artworks.description: Wtewael's jewel-like chaos: Olympians and Titans locked in the theogonic war Hesiod fixed as the cosmos' founding battle.

artworks.title: The Fall of the Titans (the Titans cast into Tartarus)
artworks.description: Cornelis van Haarlem's Fall of the Titans — the elder gods cast into Tartarus when Zeus' order wins.

artworks.title: The Fall of the Titans
artworks.description: Rubens' workshop Fall of the Titans — Baroque bodies tumbling as the ten-year war ends in the abyss.

artworks.title: Saturn Devouring His Son
artworks.description: Goya's Saturn devouring his son — the Titan father's crime that sets the succession war in motion.

popCulture.title: Titanomachy
popCulture.description: The ten-year war of Olympians against Titans remains the West's founding cosmic battle — Hesiod's theogonic war as the template for every later clash of gods.
